F1_forging: Union bound on forging the per-request key; key spaces in log-space (|Σ|! via lgamma). Formula: $P_{forge}\leq q/|\mathcal{K}_\tau|$
F2_static_asr: Bars: p̂_τ; whiskers: two-sided CP interval; triangles: one-sided CP upper bound p̄_τ. Formula: $\bar p_\tau=\mathrm{Beta}^{-1}(1-\alpha;\,s+1,\,n-s)$
F3_dro: Closed-form χ²-DRO worst case of a binary success rate, applied to p̄_τ. Formula: $g_\rho(p)=p+\sqrt{2\rho\,p(1-p)}$  for  $\rho\leq\frac{1-p}{2p}$, else 1
F5_combined_risk: Main curves per q; right: stacked decomposition at three ρ values (bars grouped by ρ). Formula: $\bar{\mathcal{R}}_\tau(\rho)=\min\{1,\,q/|\mathcal{K}_\tau|+\max(g_\rho(\bar p_\tau),\bar p^{adp}_\tau)\}$
F6_risk_utility: Each point is one defense; shaded bands are the feasible regions for each η. Formula: $\tau^\star=\arg\min_\tau\bar{\mathcal{R}}_\tau(\rho)\ \ \mathrm{s.t.}\ U_\tau\geq U_{none}-\eta$
F7_v1: SOCP solution per (ρ, η); right: composition of π* as ρ increases. Formula: $V_1=\min_{\pi\in\Pi_\eta}\min\{1,\sum_\tau\pi_\tau\frac{q}{|\mathcal{K}_\tau|}+\max(\mathbb{E}_P[L_\pi]+\sqrt{2\rho\mathrm{Var}_P(L_\pi)},\sum_\tau\pi_\tau\bar p^{adp}_\tau)\}$
F8_mcnemar: Paired comparison on the same attacks; small p = the two variants fail on different attacks. Formula: exact McNemar: $b\sim\mathrm{Bin}(b+c,\frac{1}{2})$
F9_hoeffding: Bound assumes independent runs with per-attack failure < ½; runs on the same text are correlated, so the empirical rate is shown alongside. Formula: $P(\mathrm{vote\ fooled})\leq\exp(-2m(\frac{1}{2}-\bar{\mathcal{R}}_Q)^2)$, $\bar{\mathcal{R}}_Q<\frac{1}{2}$
F10_failure_hist: Histogram of per-attack failure rates over independent keys. Formula: $p(x)=\frac{1}{R}\sum_{r}A_r(x)$, Hoeffding needs $p(x)<\frac{1}{2}$
F11_conformal: Ask user iff s(x) ≥ λ, otherwise DENY. Calibrated on one half, realized risk on the other. Formula: $\hat\lambda=\inf\{\lambda:\frac{n}{n+1}\hat L_n(\lambda)+\frac{B}{n+1}\leq\alpha_{user}\}$, $L_i=a\,\mathbb{1}[\mathrm{dang}_i\wedge s_i\geq\lambda]$
F12_loss: Stacked mean loss components; triangles: p̄_G + a p̄_C + h p̄_F. Formula: $\ell_\theta(x)=G_\theta(x)+a\,C_\theta(x)+h\,F_\theta(x)$
F13_sion_lp: ℓ̄[k,θ] = CP upper bound of the loss of style k under θ; Π: utility ≥ U_min, per-config leakage cap. Formula: $\min_{\pi\in\Pi}\max_{w\in\mathcal{W}}\ \pi^\top\bar\ell\,w$
F14_v_horizon: E-term = CP bounds p̄_G + a p̄_C + h p̄_F; Var from per-attack losses (pending author confirmation). ℓ̄^adp equals the static bound until Stage-2 adaptive runs exist. Formula: $V_{H}=\min_{\pi\in\Pi}\min\{1,\sum_\theta\pi_\theta\frac{q}{|\mathcal{K}_\theta|}+\max(\mathbb{E}_P[L_\pi]+\sqrt{2\rho\mathrm{Var}_P(L_\pi)},\sum_\theta\pi_\theta\bar\ell^{adp}_\theta)\}$
F15_leakage: Representative schemas (email, date, bool). side-channel leakage term is a placeholder (not measured). Formula: $\mathrm{leak}(\theta)=\sum_{outputs}\log_2|S|+L_{side}$
